prompt: I have an existing Rust HTTP server using axum that listens on port 3000. I need to daemonize it — add systemd integration with Type=notify and watchdog support, a health check endpoint at /health, PID file management, and graceful shutdown that drains in-flight HTTP requests before exiting. The binary is called 'api-gateway'.

assertions.text: systemd unit file uses Type=notify (not Type=simple)
Source code implements systemd watchdog pinging (WatchdogSec + sd_notify Watchdog)
Source code exposes a /health HTTP endpoint
Source code implements PID file creation and cleanup
Graceful shutdown includes draining in-flight HTTP requests with a timeout
Source code calls sd_notify for Ready and Stopping states
systemd unit file includes security hardening directives (NoNewPrivileges, ProtectSystem, etc.)
